breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt provided contradictory boundary conditions: both Neumann (u_x=0) and Dirichlet (u=0). The agent correctly resolved this by omitting the contradictory Dirichlet condition, aligning with the ground truth which only specifies the Neumann conditions.
